stemMd: Unit-cube stacks occupy a two-by-two grid. At left-front, left-back, right-front and right-back their heights are respectively 1,3,2,1. Viewed orthographically from the front, what are the visible silhouette heights from left to right?
explanationMd: A front silhouette collapses depth, so each left-right column shows its maximum stack height. Left is max(1,3)=3 and right max(2,1)=2.

distractorRationale.a: This uses only selected low stacks.
distractorRationale.b: This ignores the taller rear-left stack.
distractorRationale.c: This ignores the taller front-right stack.
distractorRationale.e: This adds depths rather than taking maximum heights.
